sentences.text:
It is submitted by learned counsel for the parties that the parties have already entered into compromise, copy of compromise letter is appended as Annexure No.4 (page 40 of the paper-book)
to the affidavit.
It is argued that in view of the compromise, the opposite party does not want to proceed with the case.

Learned counsel for the parties argued that parties will file aforesaid compromise letter before the court below and sought a direction to the concerned court below for the verification of the said compromise.
4.

Accordingly, the parties are directed to appear before the court below along with certified copy of this order and original copy of the compromised letter and move an application for verification of the aforesaid compromise within a period of three weeks from today before the Court concerned.

If such an application along with compromise lettr will be filed within stipulated period, the court below is directed to verify the contents of the aforesaid compromise letter and after verifying the same, obtained the signatures of the parties to the aforesaid compromise and both the parties put their signatures and made statement that they were entered into the compromise voluntarily.
5.

In case, the Court concerned finds that the parties have entered into the compromise voluntarily and they do not want to proceed with the matter, the Court below will pass appropriate orders in the matter.
6. With the aforesaid observations, the application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed off.

Order Date :- 21.7.2023/saqlain  Mahaveer And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34341797/
